name: Hua Nan Financial Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Hua Nan Financial Holdings Co., Ltd., through its various subsidiaries, delivers a comprehensive array of financial services to clients both in Taiwan and across global markets. The firm’s banking sector encompasses commercial, offshore, and international branch operations, alongside other general banking solutions. Beyond traditional banking, it actively participates in the securities market, offering services such as trading, underwriting, transfer agency, margin lending, securities financing, futures transactions, and facilitating foreign securities purchases and sales. Its extensive service portfolio also includes property insurance—covering automotive, fire, casualty, and liability policies—in addition to providing reinsurance for these lines of business. Further extending its reach, Hua Nan provides investment trust and venture capital services, alongside robust asset management solutions involving property acquisition, leasing, appraisal, auction, and general administration. Concluding its diverse offerings are financing and leasing programs, brokerage services, and expert futures consulting. The company, which has its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan, was established in 1919.
